name: Finance general ledger journal entries and document numbering
description: User views General Ledger journal entries, debit/credit balance validations, and document numbering settings.

planSteps.description: Navigate to General Ledger under the Finance menu
Verify Journal Entries list displays entry number, posting date, total debit, total credit, and status
Click on Document Numbering Settings button in the toolbar
Verify document numbering modal opens with automatic prefix, sequence, and year fields
